statement: The geometrically prime-to-two point-section map is injective for ordinary genus-two curves y^2+y=a*x+b/x+c/(x+1), abc nonzero, satisfying (a+b+c)^3+abc=0, over finitely generated characteristic-two fields; also for finite-extension forms and hyperbolic open subcurves.
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.17–17v; scans35–36: main point-separation question A1 and covering condition A2. This is a modern result or audit criterion, not a claimed manuscript assertion.
notes: Explicit connected cyclic cubic cover and two jointly point-injective maps to a smooth supersingular elliptic curve. Complete local fibre check and Cech Hasse-invariant computation. Parameterization b=a*v^3, c=a*(v+1)^3. All normalizations checked in code/A_char2_extension_checks.py.

statement: For the ordinary family C_{a,b,c}, a supersingular elliptic quotient of a connected cyclic cubic etale cover exists exactly when (a+b+c)^3+abc=0. If this fails every such cover has ordinary Jacobian. The curve with (a,b,c)=(1,1,alpha), alpha^2+alpha+1=0, is an explicit example. For the 2-rank-one family y^2+y=a*x^3+b*x+c/x, ac nonzero, all lifted-involution elliptic quotients of cyclic cubic etale covers are ordinary.
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.17–17v; scans35–36: main point-separation question A1 and covering condition A2. This is a modern result or audit criterion, not a claimed manuscript assertion.
notes: Exhausts all nonzero geometric 3-torsion classes using reduced degree-two divisors; degree-one cases excluded by the Weierstrass gap at 3. Proves J_D isogenous to J_C times E^2 using the S3 action. This is only an obstruction to the specified cubic-cover method, not a counterexample to A1 or to all odd-degree correspondences.

statement: The geometrically prime-to-two point-section map is injective for the 2-rank-one genus-two family y^2+y=s*x^3+x+s^5/x, s nonzero, over finitely generated characteristic-two fields, including forms after finite extension and hyperbolic opens. Equivalently, y^2+y=a*x^3+b*x+c/x with abc nonzero and a^5=b^16*c.
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.17–17v; scans35–36: main point-separation question A1 and covering condition A2. This is a modern result or audit criterion, not a claimed manuscript assertion.
notes: Explicit connected cyclic quintic cover, quotient B_s: V^2+V=(t^4+t^2+1)(t+s^2)/s^2 of genus two and 2-rank zero. Two deck-conjugate quotient maps are jointly point-injective because two different reflections have a nontrivial free deck transformation as product. All norm, Dickson, and birational identities checked in code/A_char2_extension_checks.py.

statement: The geometrically prime-to-two point-section map is injective for y^2+y=x^3+1/x over every field finitely generated over F2, including finite-extension forms and hyperbolic open subcurves. A cyclic etale cover of degree13 has two jointly point-injective quotient maps to a genus-six curve of 2-rank zero.
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.17–17v; scans35–36: main point-separation question A1 and covering condition A2. This is a modern result or audit criterion, not a claimed manuscript assertion.
notes: Full explicit13-torsion norm certificate over F16; locally exact differential line bundle O(infinity); zero twisted-Frobenius map; one12-cycle of all nontrivial characters; dihedral Jacobian isogeny and free-deck point separation. Independently reviewed by finite_field, including the Frobenius, wild-ramification, and isogeny steps. Eleven exact checks pass in code/A_char2_thirteen_checks.py.

statement: For a genus-two curve in characteristic two and any connected odd cyclic etale cover defined by L of order n, f(D)-f(C) is exactly the sum of the sizes of multiplication-by-two orbits of nonzero indices disjoint from the Raynaud theta divisor. If every orbit meets theta, two reflection quotient maps jointly separate points and their common target has 2-rank zero. For prime ell, a nonzero ell-torsion theta point and <2,-1>=(Z/ell)^* suffice.

notes: Proves B_C^2=omega and theta symmetry, every twisted Frobenius zero/nonzero condition, all composite-conductor blocks, genus-(n-1)/2 dihedral quotient, J_D~J_C times J_B squared, and joint point separation. Independently reviewed by root. Fourteen exact arithmetic checks pass in code/A_char2_theta_checks.py.

statement: Existence of an odd torsion point meeting all required doubling orbits is unresolved for an arbitrary genus-two curve over Fbar_2. Yang torsion density does not prescribe a prime order or enough orbit intersections. No normalized-p-rank-to-zero prime-to-two tower is established.
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.17–17v; scans35–36: main point-separation question A1 and covering condition A2. This is a modern result or audit criterion, not a claimed manuscript assertion.
notes: The 2-rank-one family has theta intersect J[3] equal to {0}; the ordinary family off the cubic hypersurface has no nonzero theta 3-torsion. Thus any cyclic degree divisible by3 retains an ordinary order-three block. For arbitrary n, density guarantees neither all orbits nor a positive proportion of killed character indices. This limitation does not refute A1.

statement: For a proper curve of genus at least two over a field finitely generated over F2, any nontrivial odd Galois etale cover whose deck action on geometric Jacobian2-torsion is nonfaithful proves prime-to-two point-section injectivity. Conversely a collision forces every such deck action faithful and f(D)-f(C) at least the least dimension of a faithful F2-representation of the deck group.
manuscript_passages: 149; manuscript pp.17–17v; scans35–36: main point-separation question A1 and covering condition A2. This is a modern result or audit criterion, not a claimed manuscript assertion.
notes: Proves nonhyperellipticity of every nontrivial odd etale Galois cover of a proper genus-at-least-two curve, trivial deck stabilizer of a point difference across distinct base fibres, prime-to-two torsion-freeness of the mod2 matrix kernel, and integral averaging decomposition. The bound is minimal faithful representation dimension, not the degree of the cover. Independently reviewed and accepted by root.

statement: For genus-two odd cyclic covers, the deck kernel on geometric2-primary torsion has order gcd(n, all indices in doubling orbits disjoint from theta). For odd prime-power n it is enough to kill every primitive-character orbit; proper-conductor blocks may survive. A theta point of exact order ell^a with <2,-1>=(Z/ell^a)^* is a sufficient point-section criterion.

notes: The exact F2-character formula retains all composite-conductor blocks. Degree9 illustrates a nontrivial deck kernel despite surviving order3 characters; degree15 shows why the prime-power restriction matters for this simple sufficient condition. Arithmetic examples checked exactly in code/A_char2_theta_checks.py. Existence of suitable torsion points remains unresolved. Independently reviewed and accepted by root.
